recoveryDenominatorTolerance: 1% of the larger CURRENT/NO_EROSION metric magnitude, minimum 1e-12
classificationRule: A-C require >=50% discharge recovery at both causal checkpoints and >=15 percentage-point lead; D requires no single-zone result and >=70% corridor/combination recovery; E requires CORRIDOR_ONLY >=70% and >=15-point lead over OUTSIDE_CORRIDOR_ONLY; otherwise F.
